signature.name: VTask.SupportsStmt
signature.type: {Γ : Type u_1} -> {Λ : Type u_2} -> {σ : Type u_3} -> (S : Finset Λ) -> Turing.TM1.Stmt Γ Λ σ → Prop

conventions.statement: VTask.SupportsStmt S Turing.TM1.Stmt.halt is True for every S, because halt contains no goto instructions.
conventions.note: Base case of the recursion; trivially holds.

conventions.statement: VTask.SupportsStmt S (Turing.TM1.Stmt.goto l) holds iff for all tape symbols a and states v, l a v ∈ S.
conventions.note: The label function may depend on both tape symbol and internal state; all branches must land in S.

conventions.statement: VTask.SupportsStmt S (Turing.TM1.Stmt.branch f q₁ q₂) holds iff both VTask.SupportsStmt S q₁ and VTask.SupportsStmt S q₂ hold.
conventions.note: Conjunctive requirement; either branch failing is sufficient to refute the predicate.

conventions.point: sequencing constructors propagate support to continuation
conventions.statement: For move, write, and load, VTask.SupportsStmt S applied to such a statement holds iff VTask.SupportsStmt S holds for its continuation.
conventions.note: These constructors add no new goto targets themselves.

facts.statement: ∀ {Γ Λ σ : Type} (S S' : Finset Λ) (q : Turing.TM1.Stmt Γ Λ σ), S ⊆ S' → VTask.SupportsStmt S q → VTask.SupportsStmt S' q

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; unvalidated by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ {Γ Λ σ : Type} (S : Finset Λ), VTask.SupportsStmt S (Turing.TM1.Stmt.halt : Turing.TM1.Stmt Γ Λ σ)

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; unvalidated by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ {Γ Λ σ : Type} {S : Finset Λ} {q₁ q₂ : Turing.TM1.Stmt Γ Λ σ}, q₁ ∈ Turing.TM1.stmts₁ q₂ → VTask.SupportsStmt S q₂ → VTask.SupportsStmt S q₁
